spanish: Y dijo: Porque seré contigo, y esta a ti la señal de que yo te envié: en tu sacar al pueblo desde Egipto, ustedes servirán a Dios sobre este monte.
grammarChanges: Inserted the explicit subject pronoun 'ustedes' before 'servirán' because Spanish 2nd-person-plural-formal and 3rd-person-plural verb forms are identical; after 'el pueblo' the bare verb could be misread as 'they will serve' instead of the licensed 2mp address.
readerNote: Added 'ustedes' as the explicit subject so the verb reads as address to you (plural), not as a report about 'they', per the cited 2mp form; no participant or meaning was changed.
